summary: Tested victory-lock and rally-marker features per review. Backend HTTP 409 behavior on locked games verified via pytest (7/7 passed) against the live REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Frontend flows verified via Playwright: (1) game-over overlay renders when game_over=true, Return-to-Home button navigates back to landing and strips ?game= from URL; (2) rally-select dropdown sets rally, exactly one rally-flag SVG marker renders on the rally system (non-self target). Two test-only endpoints were added to the backend (_test/force-victory and _test/give-system) to enable the E2E scenarios without playing an entire game — main agent should decide whether to keep them (behind a flag) or remove before production.

issues: Repeated React warning: 'Encountered two children with the same key' for connection lines (e.g. 'home_0-player_0_system_5'). Non-blocking but appears on every render — connection keys should be sorted-pair-based or otherwise unique to avoid duplicates.

action_items: Decide whether to keep the /api/game/{id}/_test/force-victory and /api/game/{id}/_test/give-system scaffolds. Recommended: gate them behind an env flag (e.g. TESTING=1) or remove before production.
Fix duplicate React key warnings in the galaxy connection line list (renderGalaxyMap ~L1780). Use a normalized `[min,max].join('-')` key or dedupe connections at generation time.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: `_require_active_game` is correctly wired into all mutating endpoints (/orders, /build-orders, /ready, /resolve-turn, /timer, /rally). 409 is uniformly returned. Good.
server.py: GameEngine.resolve_turn() correctly freezes turn_deadline, ready_players, and returns before advancing turn once victory is detected — matches the 'Victory Lock' spec.
App.js renderVictoryStatus() cleanly handles both game_over (modal) and pre-lock victory_status (banner) branches. returnToHome() correctly resets React state and strips ?game=.
App.js renderGalaxyMap() rally overlays: self-links are excluded (dst.id === sys.id) and flag markers are deduped via a Set(rallyLinks.dst.id) — verified visually and via testid count.
App.js still has 'Encountered two children with the same key' React warning for connection lines — pre-existing but pollutes the console on every re-render.
seed_data_creation: None persisted; each test creates a fresh in-memory game via /api/create-game.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two test-only endpoints exist on the backend: POST /api/game/{id}/_test/force-victory (sets game_over + final_victory) and POST /api/game/{id}/_test/give-system (reassigns a system's owner). They exist purely to make E2E flows tractable without playing a game to completion. If the main agent removes them, the E2E rally + game-over scripts in this iteration need alternative wiring (e.g., server-side python fixture or gameplay-driven victory). The backend pytest file test_victory_lock_http.py depends on _test/force-victory and will fail if it's removed. The frontend flow tests are in-browser Playwright (not persisted as .py test files) — see this iteration's playwright output for the exact steps.
